name: Instow Beach Cottage
accommodation: Upper Instow Beach Cottage (3 bedrooms, sleeps 5) and Lower Instow Beach Cottage (3 bedrooms, sleeps 6)
suitableFor: Families and small groups, including dog owners
beachAccess: Just back from Marine Parade; the beach is across the road
confirmedFeatures: Sea views, kitchens, dining room or living room with sea views, private terrace or garden, off-road parking
overview: Two three-bedroom apartments set just back from Marine Parade in Instow, with the beach across the road and views over the Torridge estuary. Upper sleeps five and Lower sleeps six; both have off-road parking, a garden or terrace and are within walking distance of the village pubs and restaurants.
surfTripFit: Off-road parking and a beach across the road make it an easy self-catering base, with Westward Ho! and the Braunton beaches a short drive away.
